companion.locator: §IV and Fig. 3, long-distance network and GNSS common-view reference. Live San Fernando server follows UTC(ROA). Granada client is compared locally to a passive hydrogen maser disciplined using satellite common view. The two sites are more than 300 km apart.

evidence_grade: Raw complete live WAN subset, distinct external reference clock. Fixed-site fiber network. Transferring the result to wireless or inter-robot links requires another experiment.
selection: Every CSV in dataset/roa/ was read and CRC checked: 7 ptp4l, 1 chrony, 6 directional one-way delay files. The separate dataset/clock standalone oscillator file and 13 dataset/testbed/ emulation/training files were not pooled or analyzed. Use v2.1 column names offset_true/offset_raw (ns); earlier releases use different names and units.
fields: offset_true is independent clock time error vs common-view reference. offset_raw is the PTP client unfiltered estimate and offset_filt is its optional filtered estimate. delay_raw is a one-way estimate derived from a round trip, distinct from the separately recorded direction-specific delays. Acquisition timestamps retained as integer ns. Per-variable statistics use complete rows and retain signs. Absolute p95 interpolates linearly.
joining: The simultaneous acquisition streams do not share exact event time stamps across offset_true and offset_raw in any of the 7 PTP files. Calculate distributions by stream within a run; do not report row-paired errors. The six one-way delay files are separate sessions from the PTP experiments. Half-difference of their directional medians is a descriptive asymmetry on those dates, not half the delay of a matched packet pair or the error of a particular previously recorded PTP update.
limitations: Clock error is a measured reference for clock synchronization only; endpoint application scheduling and control-loop adoption are unavailable. Clock/reference operations, filters, network load, epoch and oscillator all vary between files, ruling out direct causal comparison from these summaries alone.
